headline: MISTRIAL 🧑‍⚖️ Declared in LINDSAY CLANCY 🍼 Murder Case After JURY DEADLOCKS 🔒
text:
MASSACHUSETTS 🏠 JUDGE 👨‍⚖️ has DECLARED 🗣️ a full MISTRIAL ⚖️ in the LINDSAY CLANCY 🧸 murder case after jurors 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 admitted they could NOT 🛑 unanimously decide whether she should be held CRIMINALLY 🪢 liable for killing her three young children 🍼 after a full week of DELIBERATING 🧠!! The case against CLANCY 🩺 has both CAPTIVATED 😵 and heavily DIVIDED ✂️ the American public even spurring remarks from the US PRESIDENT 🇺🇸 himself!! There was a sense of pure DISBELIEF 😶 in the courtroom as the case and CLANCY'S 🛏️ future were left totally in LIMBO 🪢!! Her lawyer led a dramatic last ditch attempt to HALT 🛑 the mistrial and force a VERDICT 📜 which was totally UNSUCCESSFUL ❌!! A hearing later this month could establish what happens NEXT ⏭️ in the case!!

JUDGE 🧑‍⚖️ WILLIAM SULLIVAN 📢 told the jury on Friday he was declaring them DEADLOCKED 🔒 and therefore a MISTRIAL 🏛️ after weeks of TESTIMONY 📋 seven days mulling CLANCY'S 🍼 fate and the panel signalling THREE TIMES 🔁 that they were deadlocked!! The deadlock known as a HUNG JURY 🪢 does not mean prosecutors have PROVEN 🧾 their case nor does it mean the defendant is NOT GUILTY ⚖️!! A hearing was scheduled for 29 SEPTEMBER 📅 in which prosecutors could outline their next STEPS 👣 in the case!! Meanwhile the 36 year old former NURSE 🩺 will remain held on the same MURDER CHARGES 🔪 and continue to stay in the mental health FACILITY 🏥 in which she is currently housed!! Prosecutors could decide from a host of OPTIONS 🛠️ including holding another trial or coming to a PLEA AGREEMENT 🤝 with CLANCY 🍼 over the strangulation of her children Cora five Dawson three and Callan eight months old in their Massachusetts HOME 🏡!!

After killing the children CLANCY 🩸 cut herself with a knife and JUMPED 🪟 from a second story window in an attempt to take her own LIFE 💀 which left her PARALYSED 🦽!! CLANCY 🧠 does not deny killing the children in 2023 but pleaded NOT GUILTY ❌ to the three first degree MURDER CHARGES 🗡️ with her lawyers arguing she was suffering from POSTPARTUM PSYCHOSIS 🍼 and so should not be held criminally RESPONSIBLE ⚖️!! The grim case led to a series of dramatic TWISTS 🌀 and turns as the jury deliberated CLANCY'S 🍼 fate!! On Friday a court session began with CLANCY'S 🧑‍⚖️ attorney KEVIN REDDINGTON 📣 pushing for a juror on the panel to be removed after the jury indicated a day prior in a note that a member had not been following instructions on REASONABLE DOUBT ❓!!

Under US law a jury must UNANIMOUSLY 🤝 believe beyond a reasonable doubt that someone is guilty to CONVICT 🛠️ them of a crime!! The designation is the strictest standard in the US legal SYSTEM 🏛️!! It places the burden on the government to PROVE 📜 that the accused is guilty instead of the accused to prove their INNOCENCE 🕊️!! The judge denied the request and sent jurors back to DELIBERATE 🧩!! About an hour later the panel came back to say they still could not reach a VERDICT 📋!! It was then that SULLIVAN 👨‍⚖️ said he had no choice but to declare a MISTRIAL 🏁!! REDDINGTON 📢 immediately pleaded for a temporary pause so they could file an emergency APPEAL 📨 with the Massachusetts Supreme Judicial Court!!

In the filing REDDINGTON 🧑‍⚖️ asked the state's highest court to order the judge to FORCE 🛠️ the jury to continue deliberating and for the judge to QUESTION ❔ the panel over the alleged holdout juror that led to the DEADLOCK 🔒!! The state's high court denied the request paving the way for the MISTRIAL 🏛️!! CLANCY 🍼 appeared downcast as the judge made the ruling OFFICIAL 📜!! It was surprisingly QUIET 🤫 in the courtroom!! She remained expressionless but her lawyer looked visibly UPSET 😣 by the decision!! He continued to push back insisting the judge had the power to DISMISS 🙅 the one holdout juror!! REDDINGTON 📣 said he intended to file another motion essentially requesting that the mistrial be RECONSIDERED 🔄!! This could come up at the next hearing later this month!!

There will be no decisions made today said Plymouth County District Attorney TIMOTHY CRUZ 🧑‍⚖️ on Friday concerning what could happen next in the case!! He said he would meet the rest of their legal TEAM 👥 to decide whether they would pursue a new TRIAL 🏛️!! The facts are LINDSAY CLANCY 🍼 killed her three children and the evidence suggested to us that she was in control of her actions when she committed those HOMICIDES 🔪!! Outside the court on Friday REDDINGTON 📢 said he believed 11 of the 12 jurors would have delivered a verdict that favoured CLANCY 🍼 had it not been for the one HOLDOUT 🛑!! But it remains unclear what position any member of the jury took or what occurred in the deliberation ROOM 🪑!! The case gripped the country and sparked debate over POSTPARTUM PSYCHOSIS 🍼 with more than 200 members of the media crowding the court every day!!
